eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Platform] ZeebeTooManySegments
eventTemplate.description:
Zeebe has accumulated more than 100 log segments on partition {dims} for over an hour — may cause performance and availability issues, and is a sign of an unhealthy cluster.

Caveat: atomix_segment_count is not in metric-mapping-8.7.md's verified table (that mapping only covers the Grafana dashboard's metrics). atomix.segment.count is inferred by the same underscore->dot rule confirmed for every other atomix_* gauge in that table — verify it exists in your tenant (`load "/dt/platform/metrics.metadata" | filter matchesValue(metric.key, "atomix.segment*")`) before relying on it.
